an3.39:1.2: Mama sudaṃ bhikkhave pitu nivesane pokkharaṇīyo kāritā honti,
an3.39:1.3: ekattha sudaṃ uppalaṃ pupphati ekattha padumaṃ ekattha puṇḍarīkaṃ yāvad eva mama atthāya.
an3.39:1.4: Na kho pan' assāhaṃ bhikkhave akāsikaṃ candanaṃ dhāremi, kāsikaṃ su me taṃ bhikkhave veṭhanaṃ hoti kāsikā kañcukā kāsikaṃ nivāsanaṃ kāsiko uttarāsaṅgo.
an3.39:1.5: Rattindivaṃ kho pana su me taṃ bhikkhave setacchattaṃ dhāriyati,
an3.39:1.6: mā naṃ phussi sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā rajo vā tiṇaṃ vā ussāvo vā ti.
an3.39:2.1: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave tayo pāsādā ahesuṃ, eko hemantiko eko gimhiko eko vassiko.
an3.39:2.2: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave vassike pāsāde vassike cattāro māse nippurisehi turiyehi parivāriyamāno na heṭṭhā pāsādaṃ orohāmi.
an3.39:2.3: Yathā kho pana bhikkhave aññesaṃ nivesanesu dāsakammakaraporisassa kaṇajakaṃ bhojanaṃ diyyati bilaṅgadutiyaṃ evaṃ evassu me bhikkhave pitu nivesane dāsakammakaraporisassa sālimaṃsodano diyyati. 2.
an3.39:3.1: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave evarūpāya iddhiyā samannāgatassa evarūpena ca accantasukhumālena etad
an3.39:3.2: ahosi:-assutavā kho puthujjano attanā jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati attānaṃ yeva atisitvā. Aham pi kho 'mhi jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto,
an3.39:3.3: ahañ c' eva kho pana jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭiyeyyaṃ harāyeyyaṃ jiguccheyyaṃ. Na me taṃ assa paṭirūpan ti.
an3.39:3.4: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhato yo yobbane yobbanamado so sabbaso pahiyyi.
an3.39:4.1: Assutavā kho puthujjano attanā vyādhidhammo samāno vyādhiṃ anatīto paraṃ vyādhitaṃ disvā aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati attānaṃ yeva atisitvā.
an3.39:4.2: Aham pi kho 'mhi vyādhidhammo vyādhiṃ anatīto, ahañ c' eva kho pana vyādhidhammo samāno vyādhiṃ anatīto paraṃ vyādhitaṃ disvā aṭṭiyeyyaṃ harāyeyyaṃ jiguccheyyaṃ. Na me taṃ assa paṭirūpan ti.
an3.39:4.3: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhato yo ārogye ārogyamado so sabbaso pahiyyi.
an3.39:5.1: Assutavā kho puthujjano attanā maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇaṃ anatīto paraṃ mataṃ disvā aṭṭiyati harāyati jigucchati attānaṃ yeva atisitvā.
an3.39:5.2: Aham pi kho 'mhi maraṇadhammo maraṇaṃ anatīto, ahañ c' eva kho pana maraṇadhammo samāno maraṇaṃ anatīto paraṃ mataṃ disvā aṭṭiyeyyaṃ harāyeyyaṃ jiguccheyyaṃ. Na me taṃ assa paṭirūpan ti.
an3.39:5.3: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave iti paṭisañcikkhato yo jīvite jīvitamado so sabbaso pahiyyī ti. 39. 1.
an3.39:6.4: Yobbanamadamatto vā bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.39:6.5: So kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya . . . pe . . . manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjati.
an3.39:6.6: Ārogyamadamatto vā bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya . . . pe . . . manasā duccaritaṃ carati. So kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya . . . pe . . . manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjati.
an3.39:6.7: Jīvitamadamatto vā bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya . . . pe . . . manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.39:6.8: So kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya . . . pe . . . manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjati.
an3.39:7.1: Yobbanamadamatto vā bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an3.39:7.3: Jīvitamadamatto vā bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattatī ti. 2.
